decisions.reason: A cheap coupling cap accessory costs almost nothing to keep in the range, and the lack of website evidence for 2020–2021 does not show its value has failed, so the option stays open.

Box trailers are core business for a German trailer maker, and after dropping the overlapping Product F this line likely took up its demand, so further commitment is justified despite missing recent website evidence.
Low-bed trailers are a staple category with shared production and modest marginal cost, and with no evidence of failure the firm keeps the line rather than give up a likely profitable position.
High covers reuse existing trailer platforms at little cost, so keeping them preserves add-on sales, though their absence from the website for 2020–2021 slightly raises the chance of a range cleanup.
